Which behavior should the workspace-switch filter policy set when the report view changes workspace?

A) clear - reset all filters on every workspace switch
B) preserve - carry all active filters across switches
C) restore - reapply each workspace's last-used filters
Recommendation: B - the workspace-change handler in `ui/report-view.ts:30` already keeps active filters, so the default in `settings/resolver.ts:12` changes nothing for current users and needs no new state. C would need per-workspace filter storage outside the resolver.
